name: talk-to-claude
description: Talk out loud to the Claude Code session you are in. OpenAI gpt-live-1 is the voice (your own OpenAI key); your session does the work with its own tools while you talk.

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key
openai_api_key.description: Your own OpenAI API key (starts with sk-). Used only to open gpt-live-1 voice sessions, billed to your OpenAI account, about $0.05 a minute while a call is live. You can leave this empty and paste it on the call page the first time instead.

keep_transcripts.title: Keep call transcripts
keep_transcripts.description: Save what was said on each call to a file in the plugin's data folder on this computer. Off by default; the call is always summarised in your Claude session either way.
